banners.prompt:
The FIRST input image is only a blank canvas. The SECOND input image shows the printed book with its front cover (for style and dogs reference only).
Create a landscape banner for an online video course on a sales page, FULL BLEED, no white margins.
BACKGROUND: light mint #E3F4EE fading to white, soft light, subtle paw-print pattern.
LAYOUT: on the left half a big text block; on the right half a modern laptop, slightly angled, showing a video lesson on screen: the same dogs as on the book cover walking calmly on a loose leash in a park, with a big round orange play button in the middle of the video and a progress bar. On the laptop corner sits a small black graduation cap with a gold tassel.
TEXT (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Small label at the top, orange pill with dark teal text: "ВИДЕО КУРС"
2) Title line 1, dark teal, very big: "КУЧЕШКАТА"
3) Title line 2, dark teal, very big: "АКАДЕМИЯ"
4) Title line 3, orange, very big: "L.E.A.S.H."
5) Subtitle, dark teal, medium: "послушно и спокойно куче за 30 дни"
STYLE: premium, warm, friendly, modern; palette dark teal #0E3B43, warm orange #F28C28, light mint #E3F4EE and white.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic except "L.E.A.S.H.". Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character. Do not translate, correct, shorten or add any words.
- Heavy, clean sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style), large and legible on a phone.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices or website addresses anywhere (no text inside the laptop screen).
DOGS: ordinary friendly family dogs, natural anatomy. NO people, no faces.
